title: CSS Essentials
description: Take the landing page you built in HTML Foundations and transform it into a polished, professional design. Learn colors, typography, layout, and interactivity — everything you need to make websites look stunning.

modules.title: Your First Styles
modules.description: Discover what CSS is, learn how selectors target HTML elements, and add your first colors to the landing page.

modules.title: Typography & Spacing
modules.description: Transform plain text into beautiful typography with custom fonts, sizing, spacing, and the all-important box model.

modules.title: Layout & Visuals
modules.description: Control how elements are positioned on the page with display properties, flexbox, and stunning background effects.

modules.title: Interactivity & Launch
modules.description: Add hover effects, transitions, responsive design, and pull everything together to launch your styled landing page.

learningOutcomes: Understand what CSS is and how it connects to HTML
Use selectors to target specific HTML elements for styling
Apply colors using hex, RGB, and HSL color systems
Style text with custom fonts, sizes, weights, and spacing
Understand and use the CSS box model (margin, padding, border)
Create layouts using display properties and flexbox
Add backgrounds, gradients, hover effects, and transitions
Build responsive designs that work on mobile and desktop
Style a complete, professional-looking landing page from scratch

connectedProject.description: Students style the copywriter landing page they built in the HTML Foundations final project. Each module progressively transforms the plain HTML into a polished design.
connectedProject.finalProduct: A fully styled, responsive landing page for a freelance copywriter
